Interface DataAccessService

All Known Implementing Classes:
FileBasedDataAccessService, JdbcDataAccessService
public interface DataAccessService
This interface defines the contract for data access operations in the Book Recommender application. It provides methods for retrieving and saving various data entities to a persistent storage.
Version:
1.0.0 (30-06-2025)
Author:
Matteo Mantica and Leonardo Lambruschi

    • saveBookshelf

      void saveBookshelf(String bookshelfName, String userid, ArrayList<Book> books) throws SQLException
      Saves a new bookshelf to the data source.
      Parameters:
      bookshelfName - The name of the bookshelf.
      userid - The ID of the user who owns the bookshelf.
      books - An ArrayList of Book objects to be associated with the bookshelf.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs.

    • saveRating

      void saveRating(String userid, String bookshelf, String bookTitle, String bookAuthor, String bookYear, int style, int content, int pleasantness, int originality, int edition, int finalScore, String styleComment, String contentComment, String pleasantnessComment, String originalityComment, String editionComment) throws SQLException
      Saves a new book rating to the data source.
      Parameters:
      userid - The ID of the user who provided the rating.
      bookshelf - The name of the bookshelf where the book is located.
      bookTitle - The title of the book being rated.
      bookAuthor - The author of the book being rated.
      bookYear - The publication year of the book being rated.
      style - The style rating.
      content - The content rating.
      pleasantness - The pleasantness rating.
      originality - The originality rating.
      edition - The edition rating.
      finalScore - The final calculated score.
      styleComment - Optional comment for style.
      contentComment - Optional comment for content.
      pleasantnessComment - Optional comment for pleasantness.
      originalityComment - Optional comment for originality.
      editionComment - Optional comment for edition.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs.

    • saveSuggestion

      void saveSuggestion(String userId, String sourceBookTitle, String sourceBookAuthor, String sourceBookYear, ArrayList<Book> suggestedBooks) throws SQLException
      Saves a new book suggestion to the data source.
      Parameters:
      userId - The ID of the user who made the suggestion.
      sourceBookTitle - The title of the book for which the suggestion is made.
      sourceBookAuthor - The author of the book for which the suggestion is made.
      sourceBookYear - The publication year of the book for which the suggestion is made.
      suggestedBooks - An ArrayList of Book objects being suggested.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs.
